title: Thread-Local GC
tagline: Compare stop-the-world cost across four memory reclamation strategies under allocation pressure.

curves.label: Stop-The-World Mark
curves.code:
for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ alloc(); }
// GC: global mark & sweep; single global pause
curves.name: Stop-The-World Mark

curves.label: Generational Minor GC
curves.code:
for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ edenAlloc(); }
// GC: frequent minor scans of young set; rare full scans
curves.name: Generational Minor GC

curves.label: Snapshot-At-The-Beginning
curves.code:
for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ alloc(); writeBarrier(); }
// GC: concurrent marking with SATB log; brief final sync
curves.name: Snapshot-At-The-Beginning

curves.label: Thread-Local Allocation Buffers
curves.code:
for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ tlabAlloc(); if(tlabFull()) { refill(); } }
// GC: mostly local allocation/evacuation; occasional coordination
curves.name: Thread-Local Allocation Buffers

curves.label: Incremental Tri-Color
curves.code:
for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ alloc(); } 
// GC: stepwise evacuation; pause budget per slice
curves.name: Incremental Tri-Color
